walk_entry.title: The hook row names three preAction hooks; the CLI registers five, and config's calls process.exit

findings.recommendation: The walk's hook row reads 'on the root, `change` and `spec` (`src/cli/index.ts`)', and task 1.2 reads 'the root's, `change`'s and `spec`'s in `index.ts`'. `spec`'s hook is `specCommand.hook('preAction', …)` at src/commands/spec.ts:117; index.ts registers only the root's (line 47) and `change`'s (line 176). design.md's Context states it correctly, and the counts agree everywhere ('three of the five' in the register modules: spec, config, schema), so an implementer passing the option into all three modules builds the right thing; only the attribution misleads. Repair the row to 'on the root and `change` (`src/cli/index.ts`), `spec` (`src/commands/spec.ts`)' and task 1.2 to match.

commentary: Graded the proposal walk's twelve resolved entries over their sweep scopes at c5f04b3d, and checked the external log's four stale calls, each a real convergence the fresh log resolved. The neutralisation repair holds against source: `external` declares no action of its own (index.ts:320), so keeping group commands action-free makes it reject with commander.help, as the CLI does. The guard's normalisation makes the places table's residual method true as written. D8's 'three slips' matches the generated surface: three backslash-backtick lines, one in the architect body and two in the review's external-handoff reference. The one regression is an attribution inside the widest repair: the hook row and task 1.2 place spec's hook in index.ts, while design's Context, written in the same walk, names src/commands/spec.ts correctly. The residual diff lists four files, all inside the walks' edit records.
